# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplemental assessment facts that expand on the core AppCAT report for the PhotoGallery application.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency inventory grouped by functional category with compatibility notes.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - HTTP endpoint catalog and service communication patterns for the web application.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Blob-storage persistence model, ownership boundaries, and data classification notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime settings, and secrets workflow inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary business workflows for browsing, uploading, and deleting gallery images.
